meta.description: A force that pushes or pulls paths, for example towards a point in space. Connect it to apply_force.

type.description: How the force acts. A point force pulls towards its position.

strength.description: How strong the force is. A negative value pushes away from the position instead of pulling towards it.

radius.description: How far the force reaches. Paths further away are not affected.

falloff.description: How much the force fades with the distance. 0 keeps the full strength up to the radius, 1 fades smoothly to nothing at the radius.
